small.description: One bounded straightforward outcome with no material design or interface redesign.

medium.description: Several dependent steps or bounded design/shared-interface work in one contained area.

large.description: Work spanning components or system boundaries, independently reviewable subwork, substantial state or architecture change, a new integration, or significant release or commissioning coordination.

security.description: Authentication, authorization, trust-boundary, or security-control behavior changes.

secrets.description: Secret material, credentials, key handling, or secret-storage behavior changes.

sensitive_data.description: Personal, regulated, confidential, or otherwise sensitive data handling changes.

money.description: Payments, balances, billing, settlement, or other monetary-value behavior changes.

persistent_state.description: Durable state, stored records, or persistence semantics change.

migration.description: Existing state, schema, configuration, or users require migration or compatibility handling.

external_action.description: The change can cause externally observable actions through an approved provider or integration.

deployment.description: Deployment, release, environment promotion, or commissioning behavior changes.

destructive.description: The change can remove, replace, invalidate, or irreversibly transform durable resources or state.

public_contract.description: A public or externally consumed interface, schema, command, tool, API, or contract changes.

architecture_boundary.description: A module, provider, subsystem, ownership, dependency-direction, or system-boundary contract changes.
